item.title: Spotlight Feature with News, Weather and Drone Photographer Graham Hunt - Alamy Blog
item.description: Join us as we catch up with Graham Hunt for our last News, Sports and Entertaintment Spotlight of 2025.

item.title: Instagram Feature with Travel Photographer Jens Benninghofen - Alamy Blog
item.description: Starting 2026 as we mean to go on, we're bringing you the first Spotlight of the year with Jens Benninghofen, who has an incredible collection of travel images.

item.title: Spotlight Feature with News photographer Richard Milnes - Alamy Blog
item.description: Kicking off the new year in our news, sports, and entertainment feature we’ve spoken to Richard Milnes a freelance photojournalist based in Sydney, Australia. Richard photographs a variety of different news topics and specialises in protests and red carpet events.

item.title: Instagram feature with Landscape and Drone photographer Denys Bilytskyi - Alamy Blog
item.description: Take a journey with us as we uncover why Denys fell in love with photographing the mountains, what has been his favourite landscapes to capture and how he prepares to use his drone to strive for the perfect composition.

item.title: Spotlight Feature with Sports photographer Andrew Orchard - Alamy Blog
item.description: Take a break from watching the excitement on the TV and join us and Andrew behind the scenes, to learn how he spends his time photographing the action during the sporting season

item.title: The Wonderful World of Wes Anderson - Alamy Blog
item.description: Explore elements that make Wes Anderson's films visually unique and get some tips to inspire you to make your own Anderson-esque photos.

item.title: Beyond The Track: Formula 1 Through Time - Alamy Blog
item.description: As we gear up for another season of F1 to be swept away with all the speeding action, we’re taking this opportunity to reflect on its history

item.title: Spotlight Feature with Music and Entertainment Photographer Izzy Clayton - Alamy Blog
item.description: For this month’s NSE spotlight we had the pleasure to chat to Izzy Clayton, a UK based Music and Entertainment Photographer. Izzy is passionate about music and this is evident in her experience and commitment to covering a large number of bands in her home town of Manchester as well as further afield, resulting in fantastic images which capture the pure buzz and excitement that only live performance can provide.

item.title: Instagram feature with Fine Art Landscape photographer Stefano Orazzini - Alamy Blog
item.description: Capturing the glory of Italy's rolling hills, Stefano has transformed his home region into works of art.

item.title: Archive Feature with North News & Pictures - Alamy Blog
item.description: Our next Archive feature focuses on British News, Sports and Entertainment agency North News & Pictures who joined Alamy back in late 2025 sharing with us their immense archive that they've been adding to over the last 40 years.
